summary.intent: Run the full post-execute-phase loop for GSD Phase 66 autonomously: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit CLI → ship → resolve PR reviews.
summary.outcome: Completed verify (pre-passed), security audit (found and fixed 1 blocking threat T-66-E1), SDK E2E gate (green, 11 passed/0 failed across phase-relevant suites), and simplify cleanups (dead files removed, unused param dropped). Session cut off before validate, ship, and PR review steps.

repo: Phase 66 deleted all 5 shares spec files (share-invite.service.spec.ts and 4 others) without replacing them for the new descriptor-ref model — the entire reshaped shares module has zero unit test coverage post-phase.

SDK E2E suite has 89 pre-existing D-01 milestone quarantine skips across 11 suites (share-operations, invite-link, folder-crud, file-operations, etc.) — these predate Phase 66 and are not regressions. Only 4 suites are active.
ApiSchemaCutover migration was already applied to cipherbox_test DB prior to E2E run — no action needed.
All 9 Phase 66 PLANs carry formal <threat_model> blocks (register_authored_at_plan_time: true, ASVS L1) enabling per-threat mitigation verification.
GSD security enforcement hook is disabled in project config (no active secure-phase step hook) — ship-phase must run the audit manually regardless.
UpdateEncryptedKeyDto (shares/dto/) and shares/types.ts are completely dead: only self/barrel/generated-dist references remain after the schema cutover.

code.finding: Security bug T-66-E1: comment claims write grant is presence-derived from invite.writeDescriptorRef (D-09 mitigation), but code only checked dto.writeDescriptorRef — a read-only invite could yield a write grant. Fixed by gating dto.writeDescriptorRef on invite.writeDescriptorRef !== null.
Stale comment referencing old pre-cutover behavior removed during simplify pass.
_publicKey? param in private upsertIpnsRecord method was unused (underscore-flagged) with a single caller — safe to remove without behavior change, confirmed by 174 passing IPNS unit tests.
Dead barrel export for UpdateEncryptedKeyDto removed after confirming zero non-self importers.

workflow: Run security audit and simplify review as concurrent subagents — both are read-only and independent, saving significant wall time.
SDK E2E build chain must be rebuilt (pnpm filter chain for crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→api) before running the gate so dist matches CI; skipping this risks stale integration behavior.
CodeRabbit CLI (coderabbit review --agent) can fail with a service connection error on first attempt — always retry once before treating as a code issue.
After applying security fixes that touch API service methods, restart the API from rebuilt dist and re-run the E2E publish-gate suite to confirm end-to-end behavior, not just unit tests.
Confirm E2E skips are pre-existing (git log on quarantine comments) before trusting a green result — a large skip count can mask regressions in quarantined suites.
The IPNS unit spec suite's intentional DB-failure negative test logs ERROR but still passes — not a signal to investigate.

friction: CodeRabbit CLI failed first attempt with a service connection error — had to retry, adding ~5 min latency.
GSD secure-phase step hook is disabled in config so the standard workflow short-circuits with 'Security enforcement disabled' — had to bypass and run the audit manually.
Stale API process was holding :3000 after the background build; required kill before restart.
gh pr edit is broken on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — all PR body edits must go through gh api -X PATCH, adding friction to the ship step.
git push / git fetch are sandbox-blocked — every push requires disabling the sandbox, a manual interruption of the autonomous flow.
89 pre-existing D-01 skips in the SDK E2E suite create noise that must be actively confirmed as pre-existing rather than new regressions.
